install: Author source audit: all 6 candidate drafts preserve decision-critical meaning; no unsupported material claims.
Both masked judgments: candidate scores at least 3/4 on every dimension for all 6 cases.
No more than one case with a stable preference excluding candidate and including previous across both orders.
All four targeted regression cases pass their original contracts.
Both source-blind candidate reader probes answer all 3 questions correctly.
Installed native invocation smoke reads current SKILL.md and document reference and preserves source meaning.
decision.preference_claim: Only report observed preference gain if candidate is a unique winner in both orders on at least 4 of 6 cases, with zero stable losses to previous. Otherwise report no clear preference gain. Never infer human comprehension benefit or cross-model generality.
decision.revision: Do not tune frozen candidate or reuse case outputs to claim held-out gains. If gates fail, record failure and diagnose; a revised candidate needs a separate frozen evaluation.
decision.missing: A transport failure is missing, not a semantic loss. One identical retry is allowed within 40 total; incomplete acceptance evidence prevents upgrade.
decision.scores: 1 hard to use;2 material reorganization;3 minor local improvement;4 ready to use. No length/format proxy as readability outcome.

privacy: Only authored synthetic fixtures and aggregate grades enter Git. Prompts, responses, transcripts and copied auth remain outside Git; copied auth deleted after each run.
limits: Single generator and judge model family; correlated preferences remain.
Order reversal checks position sensitivity, not sampling uncertainty.
Small synthetic sample; no human readers, actual reading times or comprehension study.

source_basis.use: Purpose and consistent terminology; Korean implementation is an adaptation, not compliance.
Procedural/descriptive scope and transferable principles; not English vocabulary or fixed word limits.
